title: CartesBancairesResource
description: Contains details for Cartes Bancaires specific fields in the authentication outcomes.

avalgo.description: The cryptogram calculation algorithm used by the card Issuer's ACS to calculate the Authentication cryptogram. Also known as cavvAlgorithm. ARes/RReq messageExtension: `CB-AVALGO`

cb_exemption.description: The exemption indicator returned from Cartes Bancaires in the ARes. This is a 3 byte bitmap (lowest significant byte first and most significant bit first) that has been Base64 encoded. String (4 characters). ARes message extension: `CB-EXEMPTION`

cb_score.description: The risk score returned from Cartes Bancaires in the ARes. Numeric value 0-99. ARes/RReq message extension: `CB-SCORE`
